description:
One of the Largest Studio Apartments in Portland House | 5-Year Tenant in Situ | 14.1% Gross Yield

An excellent investment opportunity to acquire one of the largest studio apartments within the sought-after Portland House development on The Kingsway, Swansea City Centre.

The property is currently let to a tenant who has been in occupation for approximately 5 years, paying £725 pcm (£8,700 per annum), providing an established rental income from day one and making this an ideal investment for a landlord seeking a property with a strong rental history.

Based on the current purchase price, the property offers an attractive 14.1% gross rental yield before ground rent, making it a particularly appealing investment opportunity.

Situated on the second floor, the spacious studio offers a generous open-plan living and sleeping area, contemporary fitted kitchen with integrated appliances and a modern shower room. Further benefits include gas central heating, double glazing, secure intercom entry and communal laundry facilities.

Ideally located in the heart of Swansea City Centre, within easy walking distance of shops, restaurants, Swansea Marina, the waterfront and excellent transport links.

A rare opportunity to acquire one of the larger studios in Portland House with a long-standing tenant and strong rental return. 979 years remaining on the lease
